title: STI Open Science Center
subtitle: Science and technology innovation platform
description: A digital platform for the Open Science Center under Uganda's Science, Technology and Innovation (STI) ecosystem. The platform supports open science initiatives, research collaboration, and technology innovation across Ugandan institutions.
problem: Uganda's science and technology institutions need a unified digital platform to coordinate open science initiatives, share research outputs, and foster collaboration between universities, research institutions, and innovation hubs. Fragmented communication hinders the impact of publicly funded research.
role: Built the platform including content management for research outputs, collaboration tools for participating institutions, and the public-facing interface for sharing STI developments with the broader community.
approach: Developed a content-driven platform with structured publication management, institutional collaboration features, and a public portal for disseminating science and technology news. Focused on accessibility and multilingual support to serve diverse institutional audiences.
hardestDecision: Creating a system that accommodates the varying digital maturity of participating institutions — some have dedicated research offices while others are building capacity from scratch. The platform needed to be useful for both without overwhelming either.
outcome: Live at osc.sti.go.ug, supporting Uganda's open science and innovation ecosystem.
whatIdChange: Would implement a research data repository integration, add automated citation and impact tracking, and build mobile-optimized interfaces for field researchers.
